Description: Per-subject candidate selection metrics for the scene-areas-hierarchy-rsa post

mean_fd.Description: Mean framewise displacement across the 4 bold runs, each computed from 50 evenly-spaced consecutive frame pairs per run

sd_dvars.Description: Standard deviation of frame-to-frame DVARS within a run, computed after dividing the signal by its most common value and multiplying by 1000, then taking the worst (maximum) value across the 4 runs

hnd_accuracy.Description: Proportion of HND (head-nod detection) trials answered correctly, across all 4 bold runs
